name: liquid-glass-weather
title: Liquid Glass Weather
blurb: Weather forecast display using liquid glass cards and weather icons.
description: A weather-themed layout using LiquidGlassCard components with weather icons, time, and temperature data in a grid. Shows hourly and daily forecasts.
use_when: Weather apps, dashboards, or forecast displays where glassmorphic cards create a premium, air-themed aesthetic.
avoid_when: Text-heavy content where high blur intensity could reduce readability of detailed forecasts.
a11y: Weather icons are semantic; time and temperature are text-readable. Icons pair with numerical data for clarity.
